description: We are Apollo4, a team passionate about space exploration, technology, and innovation. Our interests include software development, AI/ML, and creative problem-solving. We welcome curious, committed teammates with skills in coding, game design, animation, graphic design, and education to build an engaging Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer together.

details: BEYOND EARTH is an interactive educational Moon exploration game that allows players to experience a lunar mission, from spacecraft launch and cargo planning to lunar landing, rover exploration, scientific scanning, and outpost construction. It incorporates NASA open scientific data, resource management, terrain analysis, and an AI-powered mission assistant called AURA to provide an engaging and realistic learning experience. Developed using React, TypeScript, Phaser, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, and Lovable, the project aims to make space science accessible while improving strategic thinking, problem-solving, and scientific awareness through interactive gameplay.
